milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the hanging lanterns at the entrance (Z=5) and face them. Target is the center lantern at (0, 3, 5). max_distance=8 allows detection from within the entrance area while requiring the player to be inside or near the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the lanterns.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to and face the light gray stained glass pane partition on the left wall at Z=7, X=-3, Y=2 (center of the pane cluster). max_distance=8 requires the player to be inside the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the left wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to and face the cyan stained glass partition on the right wall at Z=7, X=3, Y=2 (center of the glass cluster). max_distance=8 requires the player to be inside the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the right wall.

Uses inventory_has because mining a prismarine brick slab with an iron pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 prismarine_brick_slab in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
